section: Structure of the Indian financial system - banks, NBFCs, development finance institutions, cooperatives

accepted.s: In September 2018, the default of which entity set off a liquidity crisis in India?
o: Dewan Housing Finance Corporation Limited
Tata Sons Private Limited
Infrastructure Leasing & Financial Services Limited
National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development
accepted.x: Defaults by Infrastructure Leasing & Financial Services Limited (IL&FS), an infrastructure NBFC, set off a liquidity crisis in September 2018.
accepted.tq: Use the date-event association to distinguish the two major NBFC stress episodes.

accepted.s: With reference to the IL&FS episode, which one of the following statements is correct?
o: The RBI acquired IL&FS under the special FSP rules of the IBC.
Piramal acquired IL&FS in 2021.
The company was resolved through the Malegam Committee.
The Government superseded its board through an NCLT order.
accepted.x: Following the IL&FS defaults, the Government superseded its board through an order of the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT).
accepted.tq: Apply the wrong-authority and wrong-event trap to separate IL&FS from DHFL.

accepted.s: What was the principal responsibility of the new board appointed after the IL&FS crisis?
o: Supervising microfinance institutions in Andhra Pradesh
Managing asset sales
Drafting interest-rate directions for all lenders
Issuing banking licences to urban cooperative banks
accepted.x: The new board constituted after the supersession of the IL&FS board handled the sale of assets.
accepted.tq: Identify the specific institutional function rather than the broader crisis response.

accepted.s: Dewan Housing Finance Corporation Limited (DHFL) is significant in the history of financial-sector resolution because it was:
o: The first NBFC-UL required to list on a stock exchange
The first DFI established in India
The first financial services company resolved under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code
The first NBFC to be regulated under the SBR framework
accepted.x: DHFL, in 2019, became the first financial services company to be resolved under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC).
accepted.tq: Test the distinctive first associated with DHFL rather than its acquirer or year of acquisition.

accepted.s: The resolution of DHFL involved which special provision and subsequent acquirer?
o: Section 227 of the IBC and Piramal in 2021
Section 45 of the RBI Act and NABARD in 2019
Section 227 of the Companies Act and Tata Sons in 2021
Section 12A of the IBC and IL&FS in 2020
accepted.x: DHFL was resolved under the special financial service provider rules made under Section 227 of the IBC, and it was acquired by Piramal in 2021.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair linking the statutory provision with the correct acquirer and year.

accepted.s: Which of the following measures formed part of the post-stress response relating to NBFCs?
o: Conversion of all NBFCs into cooperative banks
Adoption of the SBR framework and closer supervision
Withdrawal of all supervision over NBFCs
Abolition of asset-quality monitoring
accepted.x: The response to NBFC stress included the scale-based regulation (SBR) framework and closer supervision.
accepted.tq: Choose the measured regulatory response and reject extreme reversal statements.

accepted.s: In January 2026, the RBI Governor advised NBFCs to give particular attention to which areas?
o: Disinvestment and public expenditure
Urban land ceilings and agricultural subsidies
Foreign-exchange reserves and customs duties
Asset quality and underwriting
accepted.x: In January 2026, the RBI Governor advised NBFCs to monitor asset quality and underwriting closely.
accepted.tq: Use the institutional-role clue: the RBI Governor’s advice concerns lending quality and underwriting.

accepted.s: Which one of the following developments was reported in August–September 2026 in relation to Tata Sons?
o: It was classified as an NBFC-UL and directed to list.
It acquired DHFL under Section 227 of the IBC.
It was converted into a development finance institution.
It became the first urban cooperative bank licensed by the RBI.
accepted.x: Tata Sons was named an NBFC-UL and was directed to list in August–September 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the entity-action-year combination to avoid swapping current regulatory developments.

accepted.s: Which of the following developments occurred in August 2026?
o: Licensing of urban cooperative banks resumed.
The AP microfinance ordinance was enacted.
The first DFI was established in India.
The IL&FS board was superseded.
accepted.x: Licensing of urban cooperative banks (UCBs) resumed in August 2026.
accepted.tq: Test a current-affairs date against older financial-sector events.

accepted.s: Draft RBI directions relating to interest rates for all lenders were proposed to take effect from:
o: 1 September 2027
1 April 2027
1 January 2027
1 April 2026
accepted.x: The draft RBI interest-rate directions for all lenders were proposed to take effect from 1 April 2027.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the announcement period from the proposed implementation date.

accepted.s: Why are development financial institutions (DFIs) important in the financial system?
o: They fill the long-term finance gap that banks cannot adequately meet because of asset-liability mismatch.
They provide only short-term working capital to retail borrowers.
They replace all NBFCs in providing microfinance.
They primarily regulate stock exchanges.
accepted.x: DFIs fill the long-term finance gap because banks face an asset-liability mismatch in supplying long-term finance.
accepted.tq: Apply the asset-liability mismatch concept to identify the role of DFIs.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the historical position of development finance institutions:
1. IFCI was the first DFI in India.
2. IFCI was established in 1948.
3. NaBFID is the newest DFI, established in 2021.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
2 and 3 only
1 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: IFCI was the first DFI, established in 1948, while NaBFID is the newest DFI and was established in 2021. All three statements are correct.
accepted.tq: Check the first-and-last markers together before selecting the coded combination.

accepted.s: PACS are proposed to function as multi-service centres in Andhra Pradesh through which arrangement?
o: Stock exchanges at district headquarters financed by SEBI
Urban warehouses under the IBC financed by Piramal
Godowns at the RSK level under the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund with a NABARD loan of ₹736.03 crore
NBFC branches at the mandal level financed by the RBI
accepted.x: In Andhra Pradesh, PACS are being developed as multi-service centres, including godowns at the RSK level under the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund, supported by a NABARD loan of ₹736.03 crore.
accepted.tq: Combine the institution, location level, fund and amount to identify the precise AP-specific arrangement.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the reach and clientele of NBFCs and MFIs?
o: They reach borrowers missed by banks, while microfinance serves mostly rural women.
They provide finance exclusively to large infrastructure companies.
They operate only through urban cooperative banks.
They mainly serve borrowers already fully covered by commercial banks.
accepted.x: NBFCs and MFIs extend financial services to borrowers whom banks may miss, and microfinance serves mostly rural women.
accepted.tq: Use the contrast between formal-bank coverage and underserved borrowers to eliminate overbroad options.

accepted.s: The term ‘regulatory arbitrage’ in the context of shadow banking refers to:
o: The transfer of cooperative banks to the stock market
The allocation of all public debt to development finance institutions
The compulsory conversion of every NBFC into a bank
Using differences in regulatory treatment to conduct financial activities outside the stricter banking framework
accepted.x: Regulatory arbitrage describes the use of differences in regulatory treatment to conduct activities through less strictly regulated financial entities, a criticism associated with shadow banking.
accepted.tq: Translate the paired concept ‘shadow banking–regulatory arbitrage’ into its practical implication.

accepted.s: Which of the following is a criticism associated with microfinance?
o: Absence of any lending to low-income groups
Failure of stock exchanges to provide payment services
MFI over-indebtedness and coercive recovery
Excessive long-term lending by DFIs
accepted.x: MFI over-indebtedness and coercive recovery practices are identified as criticisms associated with microfinance.
accepted.tq: Find the specific criticism rather than choosing an absolute statement about the sector’s purpose.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Andhra Pradesh microfinance episode:
1. The crisis occurred in 2010.
2. An ordinance arising from the crisis contributed to the establishment of the Malegam Committee.
3. The episode is connected with the development of present-day NBFC-MFI regulation.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
2 and 3 only
1 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh microfinance crisis occurred in 2010; the ordinance that followed produced the Malegam Committee, and the episode contributed to present-day NBFC-MFI regulation. All three statements are correct.
accepted.tq: Link the event, immediate institutional response and lasting regulatory consequence.

accepted.s: The first meeting of the RBI’s Payments Regulatory Board was reported in which month and year?
o: January 2025
August 2026
January 2026
March 2026
accepted.x: The first meeting of the RBI’s Payments Regulatory Board was reported in January 2026.
accepted.tq: Separate the date of the regulatory-board meeting from other 2026 financial-sector developments.

accepted.s: Which one of the following developments best describes the position of microfinance in March 2026?
o: Microfinance became restricted to urban cooperative banks.
Microfinance was completely abolished.
Microfinance experienced a contraction.
Microfinance was absorbed into development finance institutions.
accepted.x: A contraction in microfinance was reported in March 2026.
accepted.tq: Recognise the reported trend without extending it into an unsupported absolute conclusion.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following developments in chronological order:
A. Establishment of IFCI
B. Andhra Pradesh microfinance crisis
C. IL&FS defaults and liquidity crisis
D. DHFL resolution under the IBC
o: A, B, C, D
B, A, C, D
A, C, B, D
C, A, B, D
accepted.x: The correct sequence is IFCI in 1948, the Andhra Pradesh microfinance crisis in 2010, the IL&FS crisis in September 2018, and the DHFL resolution in 2019.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest institutional milestone first and then place the two later NBFC stress episodes.

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: IL&FS — Infrastructure NBFC default — 2018
NaBFID — Newest DFI — 2021
IFCI — First DFI — 1948
DHFL — Acquired by Piramal — 2019
accepted.x: DHFL was acquired by Piramal in 2021, not 2019. The other pairs correctly associate IFCI, NaBFID and IL&FS with their stated milestones.
accepted.tq: Check the year attached to the event rather than accepting a broadly familiar association.
